title: A doubly stochastic renewal framework for partitioning spiking variability
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Estimate spike-generation irregularity phi from spike trains alone and compare against voltage-derived operational-time ISI CV² for the paper’s Fig. 3 intracellular validation. The contribution phi/CVraw² is a biological quantity, not a score to maximize.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Estimate spike-generation irregularity phi from spike trains alone and compare against voltage-derived operational-time ISI CV² for the paper’s Fig. 3 intracellular validation. The contribution phi/CVraw² is a biological quantity, not a score to maximize.

Source-paper comparison for Source-reported average discrepancy between spike-only phi and voltage-derived phi; exact formula unresolved: The source reports an average discrepancy of 23% between spike-only and voltage-derived phi. The reviewed text does not resolve its denominator, signed/absolute operation and aggregation, so it is not yet an executable percentage-error score.
success_criteria: Recover the source definition of 23% discrepancy and the exact empirical Fig. 3 pipeline, including source-authorized resolution of 25 versus 50 ms bins.
Match all eight original neurons, five mice and the twenty-segment mapping; independently calibrate the native author estimator and voltage-derived reference.
Freeze the spike-only candidate before final comparison and exceed a justified meaningful effect under a valid dependence-aware uncertainty rule.
Do not count smaller phi, larger phi/CVraw², synthetic-ground-truth performance, newly held-out trials or a new cohort as surpassing the original empirical paper task.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
